en: Black-and-white postcard view of a mid‑20th‑century institutional building in front of a town, with rugged mountains rising in the background. The foreground features a long, rectangular school or institute complex with multiple stories and balconies, behind a fence and bare trees. Apartment blocks and industrial-style buildings are visible further back. Handwritten-style text along the bottom identifies the place and institution.
